Brand.combo: After Brand W Pillar of Flame has been used, hit Brand with Sona Q Hymn of Valor and let your allied ADC land a basic attack with the Q aura. If a counterattack comes in, absorb it with Sona W Aria of Perseverance, then finish with Sona Q Hymn of Valor to set up extra damage from Sona P Power Chord. If Brand isn't ablaze or Brand Q Sear has been used, close the distance and stun him with Sona R Crescendo.
Brand.escape: Brand has no mobility ability, so the moment Brand W Pillar of Flame has been used is your chance to engage. If Brand Q Sear has also been used, there's less risk of being stunned, so help your allies close in with Sona E Song of Celerity and catch him with Sona R Crescendo.
Brand.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early to withstand Brand's magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots and build magic resistance first. Brand P Blaze deals damage based on your maximum health, so don't rely on simply stacking health.
Brand.fight: When Brand W Pillar of Flame has been used, poke with Sona Q Hymn of Valor and position within range for your allied ADC to land a basic attack with the Q aura. Absorb Brand's retaliation with Sona W Aria of Perseverance. If you've closed the distance, stun Brand with Sona R Crescendo.
Brand.laning: Land effective poke with Sona Q Hymn of Valor early, but save mana by timing Sona W Aria of Perseverance to coincide with Brand's damage. If Brand sets a minion on fire, don't last-hit or stand beside it. Don't enter areas alone when you lack vision, and place wards from just outside the brush.
Brand.phase: Sona is weak early and spends a lot of mana, so survive by dodging Brand's poke. In mid game, scaling stacks let her cycle abilities faster, and in the late game, she improves her team's teamfight sustain with auras, so the longer you get past the early game, the more favorable it becomes for Sona.
Brand.teamfight: Keep your distance from allies to prevent Brand E Conflagration from spreading and Brand R Pyroclasm from bouncing, and don't stand next to burning allies. Boost your team's engage speed with Sona E Song of Celerity, then position so Sona W Aria of Perseverance and Sona Q Hymn of Valor auras reach the allies who need them. If the enemy team groups up, stun multiple enemies with Sona R Crescendo, but use it on an enemy who has caught an allied damage dealer if you can stop that enemy decisively.
Brand.watch: Brand P Blaze stacks when you get hit by abilities in quick succession, then explodes, so dodge the first ability. If you're ablaze, Brand Q Sear can stun you, so get out of the projectile's path or hide behind minions. Don't stand beside the wave where Brand W Pillar of Flame or Brand E Conflagration spreading from a burning minion can hit you.

Janna.laning: Early on, build up effective hits with Sona Q Hymn of Valor, but save mana by timing Sona W Aria of Perseverance for when you take damage. Poke the ally Janna is protecting to make her use Janna E Eye Of The Storm, and take control when Janna Q Howling Gale and Janna W Zephyr miss. Don’t enter areas without vision alone.
Janna.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Janna deals mostly magic damage, and Sona has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Janna.combo: Poke with Sona Q Hymn of Valor, then let your ADC land a basic attack while affected by its aura. If the enemy counterattacks, block it with Sona W Aria of Perseverance, then finish with Sona Q Hymn of Valor to add damage with Sona P Power Chord’s empowered basic attack. Focus damage after Janna E Eye Of The Storm’s shield is gone.
Janna.escape: Go in when Janna Q Howling Gale misses and Janna W Zephyr is also down. Use Sona E Song of Celerity to speed up your allies’ engage, close the distance, then stun Janna with Sona R Crescendo. If Janna R Monsoon is still available, account for the possibility that it could push the fight apart before deciding whether to use Sona R Crescendo then.
Janna.fight: Don’t focus damage on a target protected by Janna E Eye Of The Storm. Wear down the shield before fighting. When Janna Q Howling Gale misses, poke with Sona Q Hymn of Valor, then use Sona W Aria of Perseverance as the counterattack hits. If you close the distance to Janna, look for a chance to stun her with Sona R Crescendo.
Janna.phase: Sona is weak early and can run low on mana, so hold on while landing effective hits with Sona Q Hymn of Valor. In the late game, use Sona’s auras, healing, and shields to keep your team going through fights.
Janna.teamfight: Before a fight, move so Sona E Song of Celerity’s aura reaches your allies. During the fight, use Sona W Aria of Perseverance and Sona Q Hymn of Valor as the situation calls for. Look for a chance to interrupt Janna R Monsoon with Sona R Crescendo when it pushes your allies’ engage away, or stun an enemy attacking your carry. If Janna moves away from your carry, look for a chance to catch her first.
Janna.watch: Janna Q Howling Gale knocks up, so move out of its path when you hear the tornado. Use Sona E Song of Celerity to create distance when slowed by Janna W Zephyr, and look for a chance to interrupt Janna R Monsoon with Sona R Crescendo when it pushes a fight apart.

Bard.watch: Bard Q Cosmic Binding stuns if it hits a wall or a second target, so don't stand with your back to a wall or in a line with an ally or minion. Bard E Magical Journey can bring him around your flank, so don't leave that direction open. Also watch for when the damage immunity from Bard R Tempered Fate ends.
Bard.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early to withstand Bard's magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots to prepare for the stun from Bard Q Cosmic Binding.
Bard.combo: Hit Bard with Sona Q Hymn of Valor and let your ADC land a basic attack with the Q aura. When the counterattack comes in, absorb it with Sona W Aria of Perseverance, then finish with Q and land a basic attack empowered by the extra damage from Sona P Power Chord.
Bard.escape: The moment after Bard uses E Magical Journey is your window to close the distance. If Bard Q Cosmic Binding has also been used, approach with less risk of being stunned and catch him with Sona R Crescendo. When you need to chase, gain movement speed with Sona E Song of Celerity.
Bard.fight: Don't force fights early; poke with Sona Q Hymn of Valor. Let your ADC receive the Q aura when they can land a basic attack, and if Bard retaliates, use Sona W Aria of Perseverance to absorb the damage as it comes in. If Bard E Magical Journey has been used, close the distance and look for a chance to stun him with Sona R Crescendo.
Bard.laning: Walk over Bard W Caretaker's Shrine placed in the lane to destroy it. Don't waste Sona W Aria of Perseverance on small amounts of healing, and don't enter areas alone when you lack vision.
Bard.phase: Sona is weak early, so conserve mana and health while withstanding Bard's poke. From mid game on, scaling stacks and support items let her cycle abilities faster, and in the late game, she gains an advantage by improving her team's teamfight sustain with auras.
Bard.teamfight: Stay behind your team while keeping close enough for your aura to reach allies. Before a fight, help your team engage with Sona E Song of Celerity, and during the fight, activate Sona W Aria of Perseverance and Sona Q Hymn of Valor as the situation calls for. Use Sona R Crescendo to pass through clustered enemies or to stop Bard from engaging on an allied damage dealer.

Karma.phase: Sona is weak early, so avoid Karma’s poke, conserve mana, and hold on. Later, her auras improve the team’s sustain, so set up to fight alongside your allies for a long time.
Karma.build: Hold on with Null-Magic Mantle early, then choose Mercury's Treads. Karma's main damage is magic, and Sona has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If Karma is locking down and bursting your carry, fit Mikael's Blessing in between your core items.
Karma.combo: Hit Karma with Sona Q Hymn of Valor, and let your ADC land a basic attack while affected by Q’s aura. If Karma counterattacks, absorb it with Sona W Aria of Perseverance, then finish with Q and land a basic attack empowered by Sona P Power Chord for extra damage. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects and you need to retreat, finish with Sona E Song of Celerity to prepare P Power Chord’s slow and create distance.
Karma.escape: If the tether breaks after Karma uses W Focused Resolve, that’s your chance to engage without worrying about the root. Go in after Karma R Mantra-empowered E Inspire’s shield also ends. Once you close the distance, stun Karma with Sona R Crescendo to lock her down.
Karma.fight: Don’t close the distance while Karma W Focused Resolve is available; engage after avoiding or breaking the tether. If Karma R Mantra-empowered E Inspire shields nearby allies, fight after the shield expires. Then stun Karma with Sona R Crescendo and attack with your allies.
Karma.laning: Early on, avoid taking free hits from Karma Q Inner Flame by moving behind minions or out of range, and poke with Sona Q Hymn of Valor. Use Sona W Aria of Perseverance as Karma counterattacks to absorb the damage, and don’t spam W just to recover a little health. Sona’s aura only affects nearby allies, so after using Q, step toward your ADC to pass along the empowered attack.
Karma.teamfight: Before the fight, help your allies engage with Sona E Song of Celerity’s aura, but first make Karma use W Focused Resolve and wait for Karma R Mantra-empowered E Inspire’s shield to end. Once the fight starts, use Sona W Aria of Perseverance and Q Hymn of Valor as the situation calls for, from a range where your auras reach your allies. Use Sona R Crescendo when you can stun several enemies or to reliably stop an enemy who has caught your carry.
Karma.watch: Karma Q Inner Flame slows in an area, making it hard to close the distance. If you’re hit by the burning area from Karma R Mantra-empowered Q, walk out of it before it detonates a moment later. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects, use Sona E Song of Celerity to create distance and break the tether before it roots you.

Blitzcrank.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Blitzcrank's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first, but that resistance can't block the physical damage from Blitzcrank E Power Fist.
Blitzcrank.combo: Hit the opponent with Sona Q Hymn of Valor, then let your ADC land a basic attack with the Q aura. If a counterattack comes in, absorb it with Sona W Aria of Perseverance, then time the finishing hit with Sona Q Hymn of Valor to set up extra damage from Sona P Power Chord.
Blitzcrank.escape: The moment after Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses is your chance to trade. If Sona is at risk of being caught, create distance with Sona E Song of Celerity, and if Blitzcrank engages first, stop him with Sona R Crescendo.
Blitzcrank.fight: Right after Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses, poke with Sona Q Hymn of Valor and look for an empowered basic attack from your ADC. If you get an angle to engage on Blitzcrank, stun him with Sona R Crescendo and attack together with your allies.
Blitzcrank.laning: Stand behind minions along the path of Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, and use a Control Ward to secure vision in the brush. Focus on poking with Sona Q Hymn of Valor early, and time Sona W Aria of Perseverance, which costs a lot of mana, to coincide with incoming enemy damage.
Blitzcrank.phase: Sona is weak early, so survive while managing your distance and mana. In the late game, improve your team's teamfight sustain with auras.
Blitzcrank.teamfight: Stand behind your allies while keeping close enough for Sona's aura to reach them. Before a fight, help your team engage with Sona E Song of Celerity, and during the fight, use Sona W Aria of Perseverance and Q Hymn of Valor as the situation calls for. Prioritize stopping Blitzcrank with Sona R Crescendo if he catches an allied damage dealer.
Blitzcrank.watch: If Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab pulls you in, Blitzcrank E Power Fist can knock you up, followed by the silence from Blitzcrank R Static Field, making it dangerous. Stand behind minions, and keep far from brushes when you lack vision in them.

Hwei.fight: Don't engage first while Hwei E Subject: Torment is available. Right after he uses it, boost your team's engage speed with Sona E Song of Celerity, and if you've closed the distance, stun Hwei with Sona R Crescendo. For trades, poke with Sona Q Hymn of Valor and absorb the counterattack with Sona W Aria of Perseverance.
Hwei.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Hwei's damage is mostly magic, and Sona has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If your allied damage dealer is rooted and focused, fit Mikael's Blessing in among your core items.
Hwei.combo: Hit Hwei with Sona Q Hymn of Valor and let your ADC land a basic attack while receiving that aura. If Hwei retaliates, absorb it with Sona W Aria of Perseverance, then finish with Sona Q Hymn of Valor again to deal extra damage from P Power Chord. When engaging after Hwei E Subject: Torment has been used, stun him with Sona R Crescendo and help your allies follow up with Sona E Song of Celerity.
Hwei.escape: Hwei has no ability to create distance on his own, so the moment after Hwei E Subject: Torment has been used is your chance to engage. Close the distance with Sona E Song of Celerity and lock him down with Sona R Crescendo. If Hwei E Subject: Torment is still available, delay your engage so you can avoid its root or forced movement.
Hwei.laning: Land effective hits with Sona Q Hymn of Valor early, but time Sona W Aria of Perseverance, which costs a lot of mana, to coincide with Hwei's damage. If you get hit by Hwei's first ability, don't stay in place; move with Sona E Song of Celerity to dodge the follow-up abilities. Don't walk alone into areas without vision, and go around paths covered by the eye or ground effect.
Hwei.phase: Sona is weak early, so conserve mana and health while you survive. From mid game on, as Sona's scaling stacks and support items build up, she can use her abilities more often, and in the late game, she improves her team's teamfight sustain with auras.
Hwei.teamfight: Stand behind your allies but close enough for your aura to reach them, and help your team engage with Sona E Song of Celerity before a fight. During the fight, use Sona W Aria of Perseverance and Sona Q Hymn of Valor as the situation calls for, and move out of the follow-up area with any ally hit by Hwei's first ability. After Hwei E Subject: Torment has been used, lock Hwei down with Sona R Crescendo, and use it to stun the enemy if an allied damage dealer is caught.
Hwei.watch: If you're caught by Hwei E Subject: Torment's root or pull, you may take follow-up damage, so dodge it first. If you get hit by Hwei's first ability, move immediately to avoid the second ability and the explosion from Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. Also leave the telegraphed area of Hwei Q Subject: Disaster and corridors covered by ground effects.

Alistar.teamfight: Stay behind your team while keeping close enough for your aura to reach allies. If Alistar engages on an allied damage dealer, interrupt him with Sona R Crescendo, and use Sona W Aria of Perseverance to match the incoming damage. While Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active, don't focus your damage on him; back off and target the damage dealers behind him if possible.
Alistar.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game to survive. Alistar's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Alistar.combo: When Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize have been used, hit him with Sona Q Hymn of Valor and let your ADC land a basic attack with the Q aura. If Alistar retaliates, absorb the damage with Sona W Aria of Perseverance, then finish with the next Sona Q Hymn of Valor to set up extra damage from Sona P Power Chord. When you need to create distance, finish with Sona E Song of Celerity to slow with P Power Chord.
Alistar.escape: The moment after Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize have been used is Sona's window to step forward. Poke during that time or reposition, then create distance before Alistar W Headbutt is ready again. If Alistar engages first, you can stop him with Sona R Crescendo.
Alistar.fight: Keep your distance while Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize are available, and poke with Sona Q Hymn of Valor. Step forward to trade right after both abilities have been used, and use Sona W Aria of Perseverance to absorb damage as the counterattack comes in. When Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active, back off and let it expire before fighting again.
Alistar.laning: Conserve mana early and focus on poking with Sona Q Hymn of Valor. Time Sona W Aria of Perseverance to coincide with Alistar's attacks. Get vision in the brush first to limit Alistar's engage angles, but don't enter an area alone when you lack vision. When using Sona Q Hymn of Valor, position so your ADC can receive the aura and land a basic attack.
Alistar.phase: Sona is weak early, so survive by avoiding Alistar's engages. From mid game on, Sona's scaling stacks and support items let her cycle abilities faster, and in the late game, keep her auras, healing, and shields flowing to sustain your team in fights.
Alistar.watch: Alistar W Headbutt can charge at Sona and knock her out of position, followed by the knock-up from Alistar Q Pulverize and the stun from Alistar E Trample, making it dangerous. Sona has no way to escape on her own, so keep your distance and don't give Alistar an angle to engage from a brush. Near your turret, don't give Alistar room to get behind Sona.

Neeko.escape: The moment after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is used is Sona’s window to step forward and trade.
Neeko.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Neeko's main damage is magic, and Sona has low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance. If your allied damage dealer gets rooted by Neeko E Tangle-Barbs and then killed by Neeko R Pop Blossom, fit Mikael's Blessing between your core items.
Neeko.combo: When Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down, hit Neeko with Sona Q Hymn of Valor and let your marksman attack while empowered by the Q aura. If Neeko counters, absorb it with Sona W Aria of Perseverance, then finish with Sona Q Hymn of Valor and land a basic attack empowered by Sona P Power Chord for bonus damage. When you need to retreat, finish Sona P Power Chord with Sona E Song of Celerity to apply its slow, and use the movement speed.
Neeko.fight: Sona has trouble escaping once rooted, so manage your distance while Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is available. Right after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down, harass with Sona Q Hymn of Valor and trade from a range where your marksman can attack with the aura. While Neeko R Pop Blossom is down, stun Neeko with Sona R Crescendo to create an opening to engage.
Neeko.laning: Early on, land effective hits with Sona Q Hymn of Valor, but keep your distance from your marksman so Neeko E Tangle-Barbs can't root both of you. Use Sona W Aria of Perseverance as Neeko's counterattack hits; don't spend mana by repeatedly using it to restore a little health. Don't enter areas without vision alone, and place wards from outside the brush.
Neeko.phase: Early on, Sona has low health and attack damage and high mana costs, so keep your distance and survive. In mid game, Sona's scaling stacks and support items speed up her ability rotation. Later, her auras improve her team's staying power, giving her an advantage in extended fights.
Neeko.teamfight: Don't overlap with allies, so Neeko E Tangle-Barbs can't root several of you at once. Watch for a transformed Neeko approaching, and spread out if you see Neeko R Pop Blossom's wind-up or a suspicious enemy gets close. Help your allies move with Sona E Song of Celerity, and during a fight keep the needed Sona W Aria of Perseverance or Sona Q Hymn of Valor aura in range of your allies. If Neeko engages on your allied damage dealer, stop her with Sona R Crescendo.
Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs grows larger and faster after hitting the first target, so don't overlap with allies or stand in a line. If Neeko disappears from vision and an unexpected enemy champion approaches, consider that they may be Neeko transformed by Neeko P Inherent Glamour, and create distance in advance. Neeko R Pop Blossom's wind-up may be hidden while she is transformed, so spread out as soon as a suspicious enemy gets close.

Thresh.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Since most of Thresh’s damage is magic, Sona builds magic resistance. The follow-up attacks after being caught are dangerous too, so get tenacity.
Thresh.combo: Hit Thresh with Sona Q Hymn of Valor and let your ADC make a basic attack with the Q aura. If Thresh counterattacks, absorb it with Sona W Aria of Perseverance, then finish with Sona Q Hymn of Valor to prepare bonus damage from P Power Chord. If you need to disengage instead of chase, switch the final chord to Sona E Song of Celerity to use the slowing P Power Chord.
Thresh.escape: Close the gap right after Thresh Q Death Sentence misses, but check whether Thresh W Dark Passage is still available. The window after both abilities are down and before Thresh W Dark Passage comes back is your chance to engage with Sona R Crescendo. Engage from a position where Thresh E Flay can’t pull you.
Thresh.fight: The moment after you dodge Thresh Q Death Sentence to the side is your chance to close the gap. Poke with Sona Q Hymn of Valor and let your ADC make a basic attack with that aura. If Thresh counterattacks, time Sona W Aria of Perseverance for when the damage comes in.
Thresh.laning: Get vision in the brush early to limit Thresh’s engage angles, and change direction when moving forward to last-hit so you can avoid Thresh Q Death Sentence. When Thresh steps forward to collect a soul, look to trade with Sona Q Hymn of Valor. Don’t spam Sona W Aria of Perseverance for a small heal; save mana for when you take his counterattack.
Thresh.phase: Sona is weak early, and getting caught once is dangerous, so endure while managing your distance and mana. Later, use Sona’s auras to help your team sustain teamfights.
Thresh.teamfight: If Thresh engages first, stun the enemy who came in with Sona R Crescendo to protect your damage dealer. Time Sona W Aria of Perseverance for when damage comes in, and use Sona E Song of Celerity to help your allies engage or disengage. When Thresh W Dark Passage is thrown, immediately judge whether you can finish the target and either use your abilities or back off.
Thresh.watch: Thresh Q Death Sentence can catch Sona and lead into follow-up attacks, so move sideways when he raises his hook. Avoid the line between Thresh and his allies so Thresh E Flay doesn’t pull you toward your allies. Sona has no ability to escape on her own, so don’t approach Thresh in areas without vision.

Ashe.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game to survive. Ashe deals mostly physical damage, and Sona has relatively low armor, so build armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Ashe.combo: When Ashe W Volley has been used, poke with Sona Q Hymn of Valor and let your allied ADC land a basic attack with the Q aura. If Ashe retaliates, absorb the damage with Sona W Aria of Perseverance, then finish with the next Sona Q Hymn of Valor to set up extra damage from Sona P Power Chord.
Ashe.escape: The opportunity to engage comes when Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow and Ashe W Volley have both been used. If Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is active, create distance until it ends. If you get an angle to reach Ashe, stun her with Sona R Crescendo to create a chance to catch her.
Ashe.fight: Trade right after Ashe W Volley has been used. Poke Ashe with Sona Q Hymn of Valor and let your allied ADC land a basic attack with the Q aura. When Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is active, create distance and engage after it ends.
Ashe.laning: Look for effective poke with Sona Q Hymn of Valor early, but don't stay within Ashe's basic attack range for long. Sidestep Ashe W Volley, and use Sona W Aria of Perseverance to absorb the damage when it's about to hit. Don't spam W for health recovery; conserve mana.
Ashe.phase: Sona is weak early, so survive with Cloth Armor and Plated Steelcaps while managing your mana. In the late game, Sona improves her team's sustain with auras, so if you survive the early game, the matchup gets more favorable over time.
Ashe.teamfight: Stay behind your team while moving within aura range of your allies. Before a fight, help your team engage with Sona E Song of Celerity. During the fight, use Sona W Aria of Perseverance and Sona Q Hymn of Valor as the situation calls for. If you get an angle to reach Ashe, stun her with Sona R Crescendo, but use it on an enemy engaging your allied damage dealer if you need to stop them decisively.
Ashe.watch: Ashe W Volley pokes with an area slow, so sidestep it. Ashe P Frost Shot refreshes its slow with every basic attack, so don't stay within her attack range for long. While Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is available, don't start a small skirmish out of vision, and change direction when the arrow comes toward you.

Braum.build: Survive with Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Build magic resistance against Braum's main damage, but Tenacity to withstand stuns is also important for Sona, who has no mobility ability.
Braum.combo: Poke Braum with Sona Q Hymn of Valor, and let your ADC land a basic attack with the Q aura. If he retaliates, absorb it with Sona W Aria of Perseverance, then look for extra damage from Sona P Power Chord with the next Sona Q Hymn of Valor.
Braum.escape: The moment after Braum W Stand Behind Me has been used is your window to engage. If you're marked by Braum Q Winter's Bite or Braum P Concussive Blows, first create distance with Sona E Song of Celerity, and stop Braum if he engages with Sona R Crescendo.
Braum.fight: Keep your distance behind minions to block Braum Q Winter's Bite, and poke with Sona Q Hymn of Valor. Right after Braum W Stand Behind Me has been used, close the distance and look for a chance to catch him with Sona R Crescendo.
Braum.laning: Don't force trades early; get vision in the brush to limit Braum's approach angles. Time Sona W Aria of Perseverance to coincide with the counterattack, and don't waste it on small amounts of healing.
Braum.phase: Sona is weak early, so conserve mana and health while you survive. In the late game, keep your auras flowing to sustain your team in fights.
Braum.teamfight: Stay in the backline within aura range of your allies, and help them engage with Sona E Song of Celerity before a fight. During the fight, activate Sona W Aria of Perseverance and Sona Q Hymn of Valor as the situation calls for. If Braum gets onto an allied damage dealer, stop him with Sona R Crescendo. Avoid pouring damage into the front of Braum E Unbreakable; look for when the shield drops or an angle opens from the side.
Braum.watch: Dodge Braum Q Winter's Bite from behind minions, and back off before Braum P Concussive Blows stacks stun you if you are marked. When you see the cast animation for Braum R Glacial Fissure, move sideways off its line and avoid the lingering slow zone behind it.

Heimerdinger.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Heimerdinger's main damage is magic, and Sona has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Heimerdinger.combo: Hit Heimerdinger with Sona Q Hymn of Valor, and let your ADC land a basic attack with the Q aura. If a counterattack comes in, absorb it with Sona W Aria of Perseverance, then finish with Sona Q Hymn of Valor to set up extra damage from Sona P Power Chord. Don't use all your abilities at once, since auras don't stack to maintain their effects.
Heimerdinger.escape: Change your angle and engage just after a turret is placed or finishes a powerful shot, then close the distance to Heimerdinger himself and catch him with Sona R Crescendo.
Heimerdinger.fight: Don't keep trading in front of the turrets. Poke Heimerdinger with Sona Q Hymn of Valor, then absorb the counterattack with Sona W Aria of Perseverance. Once the distance closes, stun Heimerdinger with Sona R Crescendo.
Heimerdinger.laning: Manage your distance and mana early while using Sona Q Hymn of Valor to land effective hits. Time Sona W Aria of Perseverance for when Heimerdinger's rockets or grenade are flying toward you, and don't waste it to recover a little health. Don't enter areas alone when you lack vision, and place wards from just outside the brush.
Heimerdinger.phase: Sona is weak early, so survive by managing your distance and mana rather than confronting Heimerdinger in front of his turret setup. From mid game on, as Sona's scaling stacks and support items build up, she can use her abilities more often, and in the late game, she improves her team's teamfight sustain with auras.
Heimerdinger.teamfight: Before a fight, increase your allies' movement speed with Sona E Song of Celerity, but don't group in a narrow passage or at one spot in front of an objective while Heimerdinger R UPGRADE!!! is available. During a fight, stay within aura range of your allies, absorb incoming damage with Sona W Aria of Perseverance, and alternate it with Sona Q Hymn of Valor. Use Sona R Crescendo to stun multiple clustered enemies or stop an enemy who has engaged on an allied damage dealer.
Heimerdinger.watch: When you see the landing marker, move sideways to avoid the center, and if you get hit, move out of turret range.

Leona.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first to hold on early, then choose Mercury's Treads. Leona deals mostly magic damage, and Sona has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If Leona can lock down your carry and let the enemy team burst them, fit Mikael's Blessing between your core items.
Leona.combo: Hit Leona with Sona Q Hymn of Valor, then let your ranged carry attack while affected by Q’s aura. If they counterattack, absorb it with Sona W Aria of Perseverance, then finish with Sona Q Hymn of Valor to aim for the extra damage from Sona P Power Chord. When Leona E Zenith Blade is down, stun her with Sona R Crescendo and keep the counterattack going.
Leona.escape: Only close the distance right after Leona E Zenith Blade is down. While Leona E Zenith Blade is available, keep your distance because Sona has no ability to escape on her own.
Leona.fight: Right after you make Leona use E Zenith Blade is Sona’s chance to close the distance and counterattack. Poke with Sona Q Hymn of Valor, and move close enough for your ranged carry to attack while affected by Q’s aura. In a fight where Leona engages again, time Sona W Aria of Perseverance for when the damage hits.
Leona.laning: Early on, don’t let Leona get close, and secure vision in bushes to limit her E Zenith Blade engage angles. Poke from range with Sona Q Hymn of Valor, but save Sona W Aria of Perseverance for when the enemy damage hits to conserve mana. Place wards from outside a bush without vision, so they reach into it without you entering.
Leona.phase: Sona is weak early, and if Leona catches her once, follow-up attacks can be hard to avoid, so hold on while managing distance and mana. From mid game onward, Sona’s stacking progression and support items speed up her ability rotations, and later her auras help your team sustain through teamfights.
Leona.teamfight: Stay behind your team while keeping your auras in range of your allies, and use Sona E Song of Celerity to speed up their engage before a fight. Once the fight starts, choose the needed aura and use Sona W Aria of Perseverance and Sona Q Hymn of Valor. Use Mikael's Blessing on a carry caught by Leona’s crowd control. If Leona engages on your carry, stop her with Sona R Crescendo instead of waiting for a chance to hit several enemies.
Leona.watch: Leona E Zenith Blade pierces in a straight line and pulls her to the last champion hit, so don’t stand in a line with your ranged carry. Leona Q Shield of Daybreak can be activated before she approaches, so dodge based on distance rather than whether she has used the ability. When the mark for Leona R Solar Flare appears, move sideways to avoid the center stun. If Leona W Eclipse is active, leave its area before it explodes.

Lulu.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand the early lane, then choose Mercury's Treads. Lulu deals mostly magic damage, and Sona has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Lulu.combo: Hit Lulu with Sona Q Hymn of Valor, then let your ADC attack while affected by its aura. If they counterattack, absorb it with Sona W Aria of Perseverance, then finish with Sona Q Hymn of Valor to aim for the extra damage from an empowered attack.
Lulu.escape: The moment after Lulu W Whimsy is used on another ally is your chance to close the distance. Lulu has no dash to escape on her own, so if you get close, lock her down with Sona R Crescendo.
Lulu.fight: Close the distance after Lulu W Whimsy is used on another ally. Keep poking with Sona Q Hymn of Valor, and if Lulu counterattacks, use Sona W Aria of Perseverance as the damage hits.
Lulu.laning: Early on, stand behind minions to reduce the bonus damage from Lulu P Pix, Faerie Companion, and build up effective poke with Sona Q Hymn of Valor. Use Sona W Aria of Perseverance to absorb a counterattack, and keep pressuring Lulu and her lane partner while conserving mana.
Lulu.phase: Sona is weak early, so keep your distance and conserve mana and health. Later, keep your aura reaching allies to help your team sustain through teamfights.
Lulu.teamfight: Use Sona E Song of Celerity to speed up your allies’ engage before a fight, and during the fight stay where Sona W Aria of Perseverance and Sona Q Hymn of Valor’s auras can reach them. Be careful about focusing attacks on a target Lulu R Wild Growth can still protect. Use Sona R Crescendo to hit grouped enemies or stop an enemy who has reached your carry.
Lulu.watch: Lulu W Whimsy silences you and prevents you from attacking, so don’t close the distance while it’s available. Avoid the slow from Lulu Q Glitterlance, and don’t count on killing a target Lulu R Wild Growth can still protect.

Lux.build: Hold on with Null-Magic Mantle early, then choose Mercury's Treads. Lux’s main damage is magic, and Sona has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If Lux Q Light Binding roots your carry and they come under focused attack, fit Mikael's Blessing between your core items.
Lux.combo: If Lux Q Light Binding misses, hit Lux with Sona Q Hymn of Valor, then let your ADC attack while affected by Q’s aura. Block the incoming counterattack with Sona W Aria of Perseverance, then aim for extra Sona P Power Chord damage with your next Sona Q Hymn of Valor. If you close the distance, stun Lux with Sona R Crescendo.
Lux.escape: The moment after Lux Q Light Binding misses is your chance to engage. Lux has no ability to create distance on her own, so help your allies approach with Sona E Song of Celerity and stop Lux with Sona R Crescendo once she’s in range.
Lux.fight: Bait out Lux Q Light Binding and dodge it, then close the distance. For trades, hit Lux with Sona Q Hymn of Valor and let your ADC attack while affected by Q’s aura. If Lux counterattacks, use Sona W Aria of Perseverance as the damage hits to absorb it.
Lux.laning: Early on, poke Lux with Sona Q Hymn of Valor, but save Sona W Aria of Perseverance for when you actually take damage. Spread out so Lux Q Light Binding doesn’t hit your allies too, and briefly move close after casting so Sona’s aura reaches the ally who needs it, then move back. Don’t enter areas without vision alone.
Lux.phase: Sona is weak early and spends a lot of mana, so hold on while landing effective poke with Sona Q Hymn of Valor. Later, use your auras to improve your team’s sustain and fight for longer.
Lux.teamfight: Stay behind your team while keeping your auras in range of your allies, and help them approach with Sona E Song of Celerity before a fight. Split your approach from your allies so Lux E Lucent Singularity doesn’t catch you together. Once the fight starts, use Sona W Aria of Perseverance and Q Hymn of Valor as the situation calls for. Use Sona R Crescendo to stun several enemies, or use it on the one enemy threatening your carry if that’s more important.
Lux.watch: Lux Q Light Binding can root up to two targets, so don’t stand in a line with your allies. When Lux casts it, move sideways with Sona E Song of Celerity. If you’re hit by one of Lux’s abilities, get out of range of Lux’s attack that triggers the Illumination mark. Move sideways when you see the red targeting line for Lux R Final Spark.

Maokai.build: Hold on with Null-Magic Mantle early, build magic resistance first, and choose Mercury's Treads. If Maokai can lock down your carry and let the enemy team burst them, fit Mikael's Blessing between your core items.
Maokai.combo: Once Maokai W Twisted Advance is down, hit the enemy carry with Sona Q Hymn of Valor and let your ADC attack while affected by Q’s aura. Absorb the incoming counterattack with Sona W Aria of Perseverance, then finish with Q for extra Sona P Power Chord damage if it’s safe to attack again.
Maokai.escape: The moment after Maokai W Twisted Advance is down is your window to close the distance. While Maokai R Nature's Grasp is available, watch its root path and move through open terrain.
Maokai.fight: Keep your distance while Maokai W Twisted Advance is available, then move forward to trade right after it’s down. Maokai can’t be targeted while dashing with W Twisted Advance, so hit him with Sona Q Hymn of Valor or Sona R Crescendo after he lands.
Maokai.laning: Early on, secure vision in bushes to limit Maokai W Twisted Advance’s engage angles, and don’t enter bushes without vision alone. If possible, hit the enemy carry with Sona Q Hymn of Valor to build stacks, and limit spells aimed at Maokai that can bring forward the healing from Maokai P Sap Magic. Use Sona W Aria of Perseverance when counterattack damage hits, and conserve mana.
Maokai.phase: Sona is weak early, so hold on while managing distance and mana. Later, fight with your allies since your auras can improve your team’s sustain.
Maokai.teamfight: Stay behind your team while keeping your allies within aura range, and use Sona E Song of Celerity to speed up their engage before a fight. If Maokai gets onto your carry, stop him with Sona R Crescendo, and use Sona W Aria of Perseverance as incoming damage hits. Dodge Maokai R Nature's Grasp sideways through open terrain, and use Mikael's Blessing to cleanse your carry if they’re rooted and under focused attack.
Maokai.watch: Maokai W Twisted Advance roots Sona as he dashes in, so don’t close the distance near bushes while it’s available. Maokai E Sapling Toss detonates in a larger area in bushes, so be careful when engaging; if a sapling follows you, lead it toward minions instead of your allies. Maokai R Nature's Grasp roots for longer from a distance, so dodge perpendicular to its direction of travel.

Milio.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first to hold on early, then choose Mercury's Treads. Milio deals mostly magic damage, and Sona has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If the healing becomes a problem, get a source of Grievous Wounds next.
Milio.combo: Hit Milio with Sona Q Hymn of Valor, and let your ranged carry attack while affected by Q’s aura. If Milio counterattacks, absorb it with Sona W Aria of Perseverance, then finish with Q and land an empowered Sona P Power Chord attack for extra damage. If you engage while Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down, stun him with Sona R Crescendo.
Milio.escape: Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is his only way to disengage, so the window to go in is after he uses it. Close the distance, then lock Milio down with Sona R Crescendo. When your allies chase, use the slow from Sona P Power Chord empowered by finishing with Sona E Song of Celerity.
Milio.fight: Your chance to close the distance on Milio is after Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down. Poke with Sona Q Hymn of Valor and let your ranged carry attack while affected by the aura. When the counterattack hits, absorb the damage with Sona W Aria of Perseverance.
Milio.laning: Sona is weak early and spends a lot of mana, so focus on landing effective hits with Sona Q Hymn of Valor and building stacks. Time Sona W Aria of Perseverance for when damage hits, such as during Milio’s counterattack, and don’t spam it for a small heal. Keep Milio’s healing in mind, but manage the lane without running out of mana in a drawn-out trade.
Milio.phase: Sona is weak early, so conserve mana and health while holding on. Sona also gets stronger later, but Milio’s team composition also scales with time, so watch out for Milio’s healing in the late game.
Milio.teamfight: Stay behind your team while keeping your auras in range of your allies, and use Sona E Song of Celerity to speed up their engage before a fight. During the fight, use Sona W Aria of Perseverance and Sona Q Hymn of Valor as the situation calls for, and move close to pass your aura to your allies. If Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down and you can reach Milio himself, lock him down first with Sona R Crescendo to cut off the enemy team’s sustain.
Milio.watch: Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick knocks back the first enemy hit and slows in an area. Delay the fight while Milio W Cozy Campfire is active and increases the enemy carry’s range. Milio R Breath of Life heals and grants tenacity, so be mindful of the fight lasting longer after he uses it.

Morgana.build: Hold on with Null-Magic Mantle early, then choose Mercury's Treads. Morgana’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If Morgana can lock down your carry and let the enemy team burst them, fit Mikael's Blessing between your core items.
Morgana.combo: After dodging Morgana Q Dark Binding, poke with Sona Q Hymn of Valor and let your ADC attack while affected by its aura. Absorb the counterattack with Sona W Aria of Perseverance, then finish with Sona Q Hymn of Valor to add extra damage with Sona P Power Chord’s empowered attack. If Morgana E Black Shield is down and you have an opening to engage, stun the target with Sona R Crescendo and help your allies engage with Sona E Song of Celerity.
Morgana.escape: The moment Morgana Q Dark Binding misses and Morgana E Black Shield is down is your chance to engage. Morgana has no ability to create distance on her own, so close in and hit Sona R Crescendo then. When Sona needs to retreat, gain speed with Sona E Song of Celerity, and if low on health, move out of Morgana W Tormented Shadow’s pool.
Morgana.fight: Early on, keep enough distance to dodge Morgana Q Dark Binding and poke with Sona Q Hymn of Valor. When Morgana Q Dark Binding misses and Morgana E Black Shield is down, close the distance and stun her with Sona R Crescendo. Don’t waste Sona R Crescendo on a target protected by Morgana E Black Shield.
Morgana.laning: Stand in line with the wave so minions block Morgana Q Dark Binding. Use Sona Q Hymn of Valor when you can hit an enemy champion and your ADC can attack while affected by the aura. Don’t spam Sona W Aria of Perseverance for a small heal; time it for when enemy damage hits. Don’t enter areas without vision alone.
Morgana.phase: Sona is weak early, and one Morgana Q Dark Binding can make follow-up attacks hard to avoid, so hold on while managing distance and mana. From mid game onward, Sona’s stacking progression and support items speed up her ability rotations, and later her auras help your team sustain through teamfights.
Morgana.teamfight: Before the fight, use Sona E Song of Celerity to speed up your allies’ engage. Once the fight starts, keep Sona W Aria of Perseverance and Sona Q Hymn of Valor’s auras in range of your allies. If Morgana can lock down your carry and let the enemy team burst them, prioritize cleansing with Mikael's Blessing. Use Sona R Crescendo to hit several enemies or stop an enemy attacking your carry, but don’t use it on a target protected by Morgana E Black Shield.
Morgana.watch: If Morgana Q Dark Binding hits, Morgana W Tormented Shadow and follow-up attacks will come next, so use minions to block the binding’s angle. When low on health, don’t walk through Morgana W Tormented Shadow’s pool. If Morgana R Soul Shackles connects its chains, move out of range before the stun triggers.

Nami.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Nami's damage is mostly magic, and Sona has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Nami.combo: When Nami Q Aqua Prison misses, hit Nami with Sona Q Hymn of Valor and let your allied marksman attack while empowered by the Q aura. If Nami counters, block the damage with Sona W Aria of Perseverance, then finish with Sona Q Hymn of Valor to deal bonus damage with Sona P Power Chord. When closing in to engage, stun Nami with Sona R Crescendo.
Nami.escape: Move forward to trade right after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses. If you see Nami R Tidal Wave, sidestep first, and watch out for a possible Nami Q Aqua Prison afterward. When Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing is on an enemy, don't fight them immediately; approach again once the effect ends.
Nami.fight: Right after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses is your chance to trade. Hit Nami with Sona Q Hymn of Valor and let your allied marksman attack while empowered by the Q aura, then absorb the counterattack with Sona W Aria of Perseverance. After closing the distance to Nami, engage by stunning her with Sona R Crescendo.
Nami.laning: Early on, manage your distance and land effective hits with Sona Q Hymn of Valor. Use Sona W Aria of Perseverance to absorb Nami's attacks. Nami has low health and no mobility, so secure vision and make her your harass target. If Sona leaves lane, your allied marksman is exposed, so roam after pushing the wave or when your marksman has recalled.
Nami.phase: Sona is weak early, so manage your distance and mana and survive. Later, use Sona's auras to improve your team's staying power and support extended teamfights.
Nami.teamfight: Stay behind your team, but within aura range of your allies. Before a fight, help your allies engage with Sona E Song of Celerity. During the fight, use Sona W Aria of Perseverance and Sona Q Hymn of Valor as the situation calls for. Sidestep when you see Nami R Tidal Wave, and use Sona R Crescendo to stun grouped enemies or an enemy attacking your allied damage dealer.
Nami.watch: Nami Q Aqua Prison stuns, but it falls slowly, so sidestep when you see it coming. Nami R Tidal Wave also travels slowly, but getting hit makes the follow-up dangerous, so sidestep as soon as you see it. When Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing is on an enemy, watch out for the slow and empowered basic attacks, and keep your distance until the effect ends.

Nautilus.build: Nautilus deals mostly magic damage, and Sona has low magic resistance, so start with a Null-Magic Mantle to survive. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots. If Nautilus keeps your allied damage dealer locked down and kills them, fit Mikael's Blessing between your core items.
Nautilus.combo: When Nautilus Q Dredge Line is down, attack with Sona Q Hymn of Valor, let your marksman attack while empowered by the Q aura, then time Sona W Aria of Perseverance for the counterattack. Finish with Sona Q Hymn of Valor to use Sona P Power Chord for bonus damage. If Nautilus engages first, stop him with Sona R Crescendo.
Nautilus.escape: Right after Nautilus Q Dredge Line misses, his engage is down, so close the distance and trade. Don't stay within range of Nautilus P Staggering Blow for long, and use Sona E Song of Celerity to retreat after the trade. If Nautilus uses Nautilus E Riptide right beside you, avoid running into additional explosions before the waves have ended.
Nautilus.fight: Right after Nautilus Q Dredge Line misses is your chance to trade and engage. Hit an enemy with Sona Q Hymn of Valor and let your marksman attack while empowered by the Q aura. When the counterattack comes, time Sona W Aria of Perseverance for when the damage lands.
Nautilus.laning: Early on, keep your distance behind minions and land effective hits with Sona Q Hymn of Valor. Use Sona W Aria of Perseverance when you take damage; don't spam it just to restore a little health. Secure brush vision first, but don't enter a brush without vision alone.
Nautilus.phase: Sona is weak early and can easily be hit by follow-up attacks if caught, so manage your distance and mana and survive. From mid game, Sona's scaling stacks and support items speed up her ability rotation; later, her auras improve her team's staying power in teamfights.
Nautilus.teamfight: Stay behind your team while keeping your auras in range of your allies, and use Sona E Song of Celerity before a fight to help them engage faster. During a fight, use Sona W Aria of Perseverance and Sona Q Hymn of Valor as the situation calls for. If Nautilus engages on your allied damage dealer, stop him with Sona R Crescendo. When Nautilus R Depth Charge is available, don't overlap with your allies along its path.
Nautilus.watch: Nautilus Q Dredge Line starts his engage and follow-up crowd control, so avoid it by keeping a minion between you and him. Nautilus P Staggering Blow roots with his first basic attack, so don't stay within basic attack range after a trade. Nautilus R Depth Charge follows its target and knocks up allies in its path, so don't overlap with each other while his ultimate is available.

Pantheon.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Pantheon's main damage is physical, and Sona has low armor, so build armor first.
Pantheon.combo: Hit Pantheon with Sona Q Hymn of Valor, then let your allied marksman attack while empowered by the Q aura. If Pantheon counters, absorb the damage with Sona W Aria of Perseverance, then finish with Sona Q Hymn of Valor to aim for bonus damage from Sona P Power Chord.
Pantheon.escape: When Pantheon W Shield Vault is down, you have a window to consider engaging, but Pantheon can escape if R Grand Starfall is still available. If Pantheon R Grand Starfall is also down, lock him down with Sona R Crescendo and engage.
Pantheon.fight: Pantheon is strong in early trades, so harass safely with Sona Q Hymn of Valor and use Sona W Aria of Perseverance when his counterattack lands. Wait to attack while Pantheon E Aegis Assault blocks the front. If Pantheon engages with W Shield Vault, stop him with Sona R Crescendo.
Pantheon.laning: Early on, ward the brush to limit Pantheon W Shield Vault's engage angles, and keep a minion between you and him when harassing. Don't spam Sona W Aria of Perseverance for small heals; save mana by using it to absorb actual damage.
Pantheon.phase: Pantheon's influence falls off later, while Sona's auras improve her team's staying power.
Pantheon.teamfight: Stay behind your team, within aura range of your allies but outside Pantheon W Shield Vault range. Before a fight, help your allies move with Sona E Song of Celerity. During the fight, activate Sona W Aria of Perseverance and Sona Q Hymn of Valor as needed. If Pantheon engages on your allied damage dealer, prioritize stopping him with Sona R Crescendo over the chance to hit multiple enemies.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault targets and stuns, so don't give him range. When Pantheon uses Q Comet Spear to harass, keep a minion between you and him. If you see the landing warning for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of its area.

Pyke.build: Start with Cloth Armor, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Pyke deals mostly physical damage, and Sona has low armor, so build armor first. After that, keep your total health in mind so you can stay above the threshold for Pyke R Death From Below.
Pyke.combo: Harass with Sona Q Hymn of Valor and let your marksman attack with its aura, then use Sona W Aria of Perseverance if Pyke counters. Finish with Sona Q Hymn of Valor to trigger Sona P Power Chord's empowered basic attack for extra damage. When disengaging or helping with a chase, finish with Sona E Song of Celerity to use Sona P Power Chord's slow.
Pyke.escape: If you sidestep Pyke E Phantom Undertow, one of his engage tools is down. If Pyke R Death From Below is also down, look for a chance to engage while stunning him with Sona R Crescendo. Check whether Pyke Q Bone Skewer or another mobility tool is still available.
Pyke.fight: Harass with Sona Q Hymn of Valor from outside the range of Pyke Q Bone Skewer and Pyke E Phantom Undertow. Trade when your marksman can attack with Sona Q Hymn of Valor's aura, and absorb the counterattack with Sona W Aria of Perseverance as it lands. After dodging Pyke E Phantom Undertow, check what mobility he has left before engaging.
Pyke.laning: Early on, secure vision in the brush and approach routes to spot Pyke coming. Keeping vision on Pyke as he retreats after a trade can prevent him from healing with Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones, but don't follow into an area where you have no vision alone. Use Sona W Aria of Perseverance when enemy damage lands instead of using it for frequent healing.
Pyke.phase: Sona is weak early and can be in danger if caught, so keep your distance and survive. From mid game, Sona's scaling stacks and support items speed up her ability rotation; later, her auras improve your allies' staying power in fights.
Pyke.teamfight: Take a position behind your team where your auras reach your allies, and stop Pyke with Sona R Crescendo if he engages on your allied damage dealer. Before a fight, help your allies move with Sona E Song of Celerity. During the fight, use Sona W Aria of Perseverance and Sona Q Hymn of Valor as the situation calls for. Don't overlap with low-health allies, so you can avoid Pyke R Death From Below's damage and chain executions.
Pyke.watch: If Pyke Q Bone Skewer pulls you, you're likely to get stunned next by Pyke E Phantom Undertow, so keep your distance first. When Pyke E Phantom Undertow starts, move to the side of the path Pyke has traveled. If you see a shark shadow beneath your feet, Pyke W Ghostwater Dive is nearby, so retreat toward your allies or turret.

Rakan.build: Start with a Null-Magic Mantle to withstand Rakan's magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Rakan.combo: Hit Rakan with Sona Q Hymn of Valor and let your marksman attack while empowered by its aura. If Rakan counters, absorb it with Sona W Aria of Perseverance, then finish with Sona Q Hymn of Valor to aim for bonus damage from P Power Chord.
Rakan.escape: Right after Rakan W Grand Entrance misses is your chance to close the distance. Stun Rakan with Sona R Crescendo and attack with your allies.
Rakan.fight: Trade right after Rakan's shield is removed. After dodging Rakan W Grand Entrance, harass with Sona Q Hymn of Valor and absorb the counterattack with Sona W Aria of Perseverance.
Rakan.laning: Early on, keep your distance and ward the brush to limit Rakan W Grand Entrance's engage angles. Land effective hits with Sona Q Hymn of Valor, but save mana by timing Sona W Aria of Perseverance for when damage lands.
Rakan.phase: Sona is weak early, so avoid Rakan's engage and survive. From mid game, once scaling stacks and items have accumulated, Sona's ability rotation becomes faster; later, her auras improve her team's staying power in fights.
Rakan.teamfight: Take a position behind your team where your auras reach your allies, and increase their movement speed with Sona E Song of Celerity before a fight. If Rakan engages with W Grand Entrance or approaches your allied damage dealer with R The Quickness, stop him with Sona R Crescendo. During the fight, keep the needed Sona W Aria of Perseverance and Sona Q Hymn of Valor auras in range of your allies.
Rakan.watch: Rakan W Grand Entrance knocks up enemies at its landing point, so sidestep when Rakan starts moving. If Rakan activates R The Quickness, stop him with Sona R Crescendo before he reaches you, and don't stand in a line with your allies.

Rell.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Rell deals mostly magic damage, and Sona has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Rell.combo: Hit Rell with Sona Q Hymn of Valor and let your marksman attack while empowered by the Q aura. If Rell counters, absorb it with Sona W Aria of Perseverance, but if Rell Q Shattering Strike is about to hit, use your shield after Q has passed. Finishing with Q, W, Q lets you deal bonus damage with Sona P Power Chord.
Rell.escape: Don't engage just because Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down is down. Wait for Rell E Full Tilt to be down too, and especially fight after stunning her with Sona R Crescendo before E comes back.
Rell.fight: Harass with Sona Q Hymn of Valor from outside Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down range. Rell has low magic resistance and no way to heal in lane, so avoid her engage and wear her down. Immediately after Rell uses W, create distance; once Rell E Full Tilt is also down, look for a chance to engage with Sona R Crescendo.
Rell.laning: Early on, ward the brush to limit Rell's engage angles, and harass with Sona Q Hymn of Valor from outside Crash Down range. Don't spam Sona W Aria of Perseverance to restore a little health; time it for when damage lands. Don't enter areas without vision alone.
Rell.phase: Sona is weak early, so avoid Rell's engage, conserve mana, and survive. Later, use your auras to improve your team's staying power and aim for extended fights.
Rell.teamfight: Before engaging, spread out from your allies so Rell R Magnet Storm can't pull several of you in together. Help your allies engage with Sona E Song of Celerity, and during the fight stay within range for the W Aria of Perseverance and Q Hymn of Valor auras to reach them. If Rell engages on your allied damage dealer, stop her with Sona R Crescendo.
Rell.watch: If Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down catches you, Sona can't escape on her own and is likely to be hit by follow-up crowd control. If you see Rell E Full Tilt speeding up Rell and an ally, stop trading and retreat outside Crash Down range. Rell Q Shattering Strike breaks shields, so sidestep it and use your shield after Q has passed.

Renata.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Renata Glasc deals mostly magic damage, and Sona has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If your allied damage dealer gets rooted and focused, fit Mikael's Blessing between your core items.
Renata.combo: Hit Renata Glasc with Sona Q Hymn of Valor and let your marksman attack while empowered by the Q aura. If she counters, absorb it with Sona W Aria of Perseverance, then finish with Sona Q Hymn of Valor to prepare a P Power Chord for bonus damage.
Renata.escape: After Renata Glasc Q Handshake is down is your chance to close the distance. Renata Glasc has no built-in mobility, so if you can get close, stun her with Sona R Crescendo to prevent her from escaping.
Renata.fight: Early on, don't force an engage; harass with Sona Q Hymn of Valor. When Renata Glasc Q Handshake is down and you can close the distance, target Renata Glasc herself and stun her with Sona R Crescendo.
Renata.laning: Hit enemy champions with Sona Q Hymn of Valor to build scaling stacks, but use it when your marksman can land an empowered basic attack. If Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program comes your way, sidestep it; if you can't dodge, absorb the damage with Sona W Aria of Perseverance as it lands. Repeatedly using Sona W Aria of Perseverance for small heals will drain your mana, so save it.
Renata.phase: Sona is weak early, so conserve mana and health and survive. Later, her auras can improve your team's staying power, so the longer you survive the early game, the more favorable it is for Sona.
Renata.teamfight: If Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available, keep your distance from allies as you engage. Stay behind your team where your auras reach your allies; before a fight, boost their movement speed with Sona E Song of Celerity, and during the fight maintain the needed Sona W Aria of Perseverance and Sona Q Hymn of Valor auras. Use Sona R Crescendo to stun grouped enemies or stop an enemy attacking your allied damage dealer.
Renata.watch: Renata Glasc Q Handshake roots the first target it hits and can stun an ally after throwing that target, so stay behind minions or your frontline. When Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available, keep your distance from allies; if you get hit, use a cleanse or move away from them.

Senna.build: Senna’s main damage is physical, and Sona has low armor, so build armor first. Use Cloth Armor to get through the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. If Senna’s root lets her team lock down and focus your damage dealer, fit Mikael’s Blessing between your core items.
Senna.combo: Hit Senna with Sona Q Hymn of Valor and let your ADC attack with the Q aura. If Senna counterattacks, absorb it with Sona W Aria of Perseverance, then finish with Sona Q Hymn of Valor to land Sona P Power Chord’s empowered attack. When closing in to engage, stun Senna with Sona R Crescendo, then help your allies follow up with Sona E Song of Celerity.
Senna.escape: When Senna W Last Embrace is blocked by a minion or misses, look for a chance to close the gap. Senna has no ability to create distance herself, so if you get close, lock her down with Sona R Crescendo. When Senna E Curse of the Black Mist appears, retreat to an area with vision instead of fighting her there.
Senna.fight: When Senna steps forward to collect a soul, poke her with Sona Q Hymn of Valor, then trade when your ADC is in range to land an attack with the Q aura. When the counterattack comes, absorb the damage with Sona W Aria of Perseverance. After closing the gap, stun her with Sona R Crescendo so she can’t get away.
Senna.laning: In the early game, land effective hits with Sona Q Hymn of Valor, but save Sona W Aria of Perseverance for damage you can reliably absorb to manage your mana. Watch where souls appear and poke Senna when she comes to collect them to deny the pickup. Don’t enter areas without vision alone, and roam only after pushing the wave or when your ADC has recalled.
Senna.phase: Sona is weak early, but Senna also has low health and attack damage, so deny her soul collection with poke instead of taking unnecessary hits. Later, Sona’s auras help your team sustain extended fights, but Senna’s range and attack damage also grow as she collects souls, so it’s important to limit her collection early.
Senna.teamfight: Stay behind your allies while keeping them within aura range, and help them engage with Sona E Song of Celerity before a fight. Once the fight starts, use Sona W Aria of Perseverance and Sona Q Hymn of Valor as the situation calls for. If Senna W Last Embrace marks you, move away from your allies. When Senna E Curse of the Black Mist appears, retreat to an area with vision or use Sona R Crescendo in its area to stop the engage.
Senna.watch: Senna Q Piercing Darkness extends in a straight line through its target, so move out of the line connecting Senna to a minion or ally. Dodge Senna W Last Embrace from behind minions. If it hits and marks you, move away from allies before the root spreads. After Senna hits you once, back off immediately so she can’t collect Mist with a second attack.

Seraphine.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Seraphine’s damage is mostly magic, and Sona has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If Seraphine can lock down and burst your damage dealer, fit Mikael’s Blessing between your core items.
Seraphine.combo: Hit Seraphine with Sona Q Hymn of Valor and let your ADC attack with the Q aura. If Seraphine counterattacks, absorb it with Sona W Aria of Perseverance, then finish with the next Sona Q Hymn of Valor to aim for Sona P Power Chord’s bonus damage. Don’t use all three abilities at once, or the aura will be overwritten.
Seraphine.escape: The moment after Seraphine E Beat Drop is down is your window to engage. Seraphine has no mobility ability, so after closing the gap, stun her with Sona R Crescendo to make it hard for her to escape. Sona also has no ability to escape on her own, so don’t force an engage while Seraphine E Beat Drop is still available.
Seraphine.fight: Start trading with Sona Q Hymn of Valor when Seraphine is away from her ADC. Right after you dodge Seraphine E Beat Drop, close the gap for a chance to catch her with Sona R Crescendo. When her counterattack comes, absorb the damage with Sona W Aria of Perseverance.
Seraphine.laning: In the early game, land effective hits with Sona Q Hymn of Valor while managing your distance to avoid Seraphine E Beat Drop. Don’t spam Sona W Aria of Perseverance just to restore a little health; time it for when damage comes in. Don’t enter areas without vision alone, and place wards from outside the brush.
Seraphine.phase: Sona is weak early, so manage your mana and distance and endure. Later, use your auras to improve your team’s sustain and aim for extended teamfights.
Seraphine.teamfight: Spread out to the sides so Seraphine R Encore can’t reach the backline by following an ally, while staying close enough for Sona’s aura to reach your team. Before a fight, boost your allies’ movement speed with Sona E Song of Celerity. During the fight, use Sona W Aria of Perseverance and Sona Q Hymn of Valor as the situation calls for. Use Sona R Crescendo to pass through grouped enemies or stop an opponent diving your damage dealer.
Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets and stuns targets that are immobilized.

Soraka.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Soraka deals magic damage, so build magic resistance first. If her healing prolongs fights, consider anti-heal after your resistance.
Soraka.combo: Hit Soraka with Sona Q Hymn of Valor and let your ADC make a basic attack with the Q aura. When the counterattack comes, absorb it with Sona W Aria of Perseverance, then finish with Sona Q Hymn of Valor to aim for P Power Chord’s bonus damage. When engaging while Soraka E Equinox is down, close the gap and stun her with Sona R Crescendo.
Soraka.escape: The moment after Soraka E Equinox is down is your chance to engage. When you need to retreat, boost your allies’ movement speed with Sona E Song of Celerity.
Soraka.fight: Don’t force trades early; poke with Sona Q Hymn of Valor. When Soraka E Equinox is down, look to close the gap and stun her with Sona R Crescendo. Soraka W Astral Infusion costs her health, so you can pressure your ADC and force Soraka to heal them.
Soraka.laning: Hit champions with Sona Q Hymn of Valor to build your growth stacks, but dodge Soraka Q Starcall. Use Sona W Aria of Perseverance when damage comes in; don’t spam it just to restore a little health. Watch whether Soraka uses Soraka E Equinox to poke or clear the wave, and look for an engage opportunity.
Soraka.phase: Sona is weak early and uses a lot of mana, so endure and land effective hits with Sona Q Hymn of Valor. Later, your auras can improve your team’s sustain, so the longer you get through the early game, the better it is for Sona.
Soraka.teamfight: Stay within range for your allies to receive your aura, and boost their engage speed with Sona E Song of Celerity before a fight. Once the fight starts, use Sona W Aria of Perseverance and Sona Q Hymn of Valor as the situation calls for, while positioning so your final needed aura reaches your allies. Focus Soraka instead of continually hitting enemies who are being healed by her, and stun her with Sona R Crescendo when Soraka E Equinox is down.
Soraka.watch: Avoid being hit by Soraka Q Starcall, since it heals Soraka and grants her movement speed when it hits you. Soraka E Equinox can silence and then root you, so use your engage ability before stepping into its area. When Soraka’s damage comes in, time Sona W Aria of Perseverance to absorb it with the shield.

Swain.build: Swain’s main damage is magic, and Sona has low magic resistance, so buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. If Swain can lock down and burst your damage dealer, fit Mikael’s Blessing between your core items. If fights are likely to drag on, prepare anti-heal after building resistance.
Swain.combo: When Swain E Nevermove is down, hit him with Sona Q Hymn of Valor and let your ADC attack with the Q aura. When Swain counterattacks, absorb it with Sona W Aria of Perseverance, then finish with Sona Q Hymn of Valor to deal Sona P Power Chord’s bonus damage. Position so the needed aura reaches your allies, since using abilities in quick succession removes the previous aura.
Swain.escape: The moment after you dodge Swain E Nevermove, including its returning wave, is your chance to engage. Swain has no way to create distance himself, so close the gap then and lock him down with Sona R Crescendo. When Sona needs to retreat, create distance with your allies using Sona E Song of Celerity.
Swain.fight: After Swain E Nevermove has fully passed, poke with Sona Q Hymn of Valor and choose a moment when your ADC can attack with the Q aura. If Swain counterattacks, absorb the damage with Sona W Aria of Perseverance as it comes in. If Swain E Nevermove is down and you can close the gap, start a fight by stunning him with Sona R Crescendo.
Swain.laning: Sona has little health and mana early, so focus on poking with Sona Q Hymn of Valor from outside the out-and-back path of Swain E Nevermove. Don’t spam Sona W Aria of Perseverance for a small heal; time it for when Swain’s damage comes in. Don’t enter areas without vision alone, and when roaming away from your ADC, go after pushing the wave or while your ADC has recalled.
Swain.phase: Later, Sona’s auras improve your team’s sustain, but Swain also becomes tougher through growth stacks and healing, so build anti-heal and re-engage after Swain R Demonic Ascension ends.
Swain.teamfight: Before a fight, help your allies engage with Sona E Song of Celerity. During the fight, stay within aura range of your allies and use Sona W Aria of Perseverance and Sona Q Hymn of Valor as the situation calls for. When Swain R Demonic Ascension is active, move out of range with your allies and fight again after it ends. If Swain comes in and locks down your damage dealer, prioritize stopping him with Sona R Crescendo.
Swain.watch: Swain E Nevermove travels out and then returns, so after dodging the first wave, stay out of its path until it fully disappears. Swain Q Death’s Hand fires more overlapping bolts at close range, so keep your distance. When Swain R Demonic Ascension is active, get out of range to cut off his healing, then fight again after it ends.

Taric.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Taric’s main damage is magic, and Sona has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Taric.combo: Dodge Taric E Dazzle to the side and out of its area, then hit him with Sona Q Hymn of Valor and let your ADC make a basic attack with the Q aura. Time Sona W Aria of Perseverance for the counterattack, then finish with the next Q to aim for Sona P Power Chord’s bonus damage. Keep the aura reaching your allies so you don’t overwrite the one they need right away by chaining abilities.
Taric.escape: The moment after Taric E Dazzle is down is your chance to engage. Taric has no ability to create distance himself, so if you get an opening, stun him with Sona R Crescendo and lock him down with your allies. When chasing, boost your allies’ movement speed with Sona E Song of Celerity.
Taric.fight: After dodging Taric E Dazzle, keep your range and poke with Sona Q Hymn of Valor. Start a trade when your ADC can make a basic attack with the Q aura, and absorb the counterattack with Sona W Aria of Perseverance as it comes in. Resume dealing damage when Taric R Cosmic Radiance’s damage immunity ends.
Taric.laning: Early on, avoid close trades where Taric can hit you with empowered attacks and focus on Q poke. Time W for when damage comes in to save mana, and secure vision in the brush and river without entering areas without vision alone. Manage your distance so Taric can’t easily land empowered attacks on minions.
Taric.phase: Sona is weak early, and Taric’s close-range damage is strong, so endure while poking. Later, use Sona’s auras, healing, and shields to help your team sustain teamfights.
Taric.teamfight: When Taric R Cosmic Radiance grants damage immunity, stop dealing damage and use Sona R Crescendo’s stun to lock down the enemy and run out the duration. Time it so your allies can resume dealing damage as soon as the immunity ends. Sona should stay behind her allies within aura range, using Sona E Song of Celerity before a fight and Sona W Aria of Perseverance and Sona Q Hymn of Valor as the situation calls for during it.
Taric.watch: Taric E Dazzle telegraphs a stun, so move sideways to dodge when you see it. Don’t use your damage while Taric R Cosmic Radiance’s damage immunity is active.

Velkoz.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first for Vel’Koz’s main damage, but focus on avoiding consecutive hits because resistance can’t block the true damage from Vel’Koz P Organic Deconstruction or Vel’Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray.
Velkoz.combo: Hit Vel’Koz with Sona Q Hymn of Valor and let your ADC make a basic attack with the Q aura. If Vel’Koz counterattacks, absorb it with Sona W Aria of Perseverance, then finish with Sona Q Hymn of Valor to trigger the ready Sona P Power Chord for bonus damage. When engaging while Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption is down, stun him with Sona R Crescendo.
Velkoz.escape: Engage right after dodging Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption. Vel’Koz has no mobility ability, so close the gap with your allies using Sona E Song of Celerity, then catch him with Sona R Crescendo. Getting too close can let Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption knock you back, so confirm that E missed before engaging.
Velkoz.fight: The moment after Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption misses is your chance to close the gap. Normally, poke with Sona Q Hymn of Valor, and absorb the counterattack with Sona W Aria of Perseverance as the damage comes in. Once you’ve closed the gap, stun Vel’Koz with Sona R Crescendo and attack with your allies.
Velkoz.laning: In the early game, land effective hits with Sona Q Hymn of Valor, but don’t spam Sona W Aria of Perseverance for a small heal. Time its brief shield for when Vel’Koz’s abilities are coming in, and use Sona E Song of Celerity to get out of the announced attack area. Don’t enter areas without vision in the river or brush alone.
Velkoz.phase: Sona is weak early and can run low on mana easily, so endure while dodging poke. In the mid game, growth stacks speed up your ability rotation, and later your auras help your team in extended fights, so the longer you get through the early game, the better it is for Sona.
Velkoz.teamfight: Take a position behind your allies within aura range, and help them engage with Sona E Song of Celerity before a fight. During the fight, use Sona W Aria of Perseverance and Sona Q Hymn of Valor as the situation calls for, moving toward your allies to give them the aura. If Vel’Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray starts, prioritize interrupting it with Sona R Crescendo.
Velkoz.watch: Vel’Koz Q Plasma Fission can still hit after it splits, so don’t only dodge sideways; move toward Vel’Koz or behind where the projectile passed. If Vel’Koz W Void Rift and Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption hit in succession, Vel’Koz P Organic Deconstruction triggers true damage, so if you’re marked, back off and let it pass. When Vel’Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray starts, interrupt it with Sona R Crescendo’s stun.

Xerath.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Xerath’s damage is mostly magic, and Sona has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Xerath.combo: Hit Xerath with Sona Q Hymn of Valor and stay within aura range until the marksman makes a basic attack with it. If Xerath counterattacks, absorb it with Sona W Aria of Perseverance, then finish with the next Sona Q Hymn of Valor to aim for an empowered Sona P Power Chord basic attack for extra damage.
Xerath.escape: The moment after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down is your chance to engage. Xerath has no mobility ability, so close the gap with Sona E Song of Celerity, then stun him with Sona R Crescendo to make it hard for him to escape.
Xerath.fight: Close the gap while dodging to the side as Xerath charges Q Arcanopulse. Once Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down, approach with Sona E Song of Celerity and stun him with Sona R Crescendo when you’re in range.
Xerath.laning: In the early game, look for effective hits with Sona Q Hymn of Valor, but avoid Xerath’s heavy damage and conserve mana. Time Sona W Aria of Perseverance for when Xerath’s attacks are coming in; don’t spam it just to restore a little health. When Xerath runs low on mana, push the lane and call your jungler.
Xerath.phase: Sona is weak early, so endure while dodging Xerath’s long-range poke, especially his heavy damage. Later, your auras improve your team’s sustain, so the longer you get through the early game, the better it is for Sona.
Xerath.teamfight: Stay behind your allies while keeping them within aura range. Before a fight, help them engage with Sona E Song of Celerity. During the fight, choose between Sona W Aria of Perseverance and Sona Q Hymn of Valor as needed, and make sure the aura reaches your allies. When you see Xerath R Rite of the Arcane, start dodging; if you can engage on Xerath, target him while he is unable to move.
Xerath.watch: Xerath Q Arcanopulse passes through minions, so when you see him charging, change your direction and dodge to the side. Be especially careful of Xerath E Shocking Orb, since being stunned by it can leave you open to the damage that follows. Start dodging as soon as you see Xerath R Rite of the Arcane’s cast animation.

Zilean.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Zilean’s damage is magic, so build magic resistance.
Zilean.combo: Hit Zilean with Sona Q Hymn of Valor and let your ADC make a basic attack while benefiting from its aura. If Zilean retaliates with a bomb, time Sona W Aria of Perseverance to absorb it, then finish with the next Sona Q Hymn of Valor to aim for Sona P Power Chord’s bonus damage. When engaging, stun Zilean with Sona R Crescendo and use Sona E Song of Celerity to speed up your allies’ engage.
Zilean.escape: When Zilean Q Time Bomb’s stun combo is down, close the distance with your allies. Zilean has no mobility ability, and Zilean E Time Warp affects only one target at a time, so approach from multiple directions and lock him down with Sona R Crescendo.
