Zilean.fight: During trades, attack when your ADC receives Sona Q Hymn of Valor’s aura and makes a basic attack, and use Sona W Aria of Perseverance to absorb the bomb retaliation. If you’ve closed the distance to Zilean, engage by stunning him with Sona R Crescendo.
Zilean.laning: Early on, hit champions with Sona Q Hymn of Valor to build your growth stacks, but save Sona W Aria of Perseverance to absorb bomb damage.
Zilean.phase: You gain an advantage as Sona’s growth stacks and ability rotations build up in the mid game and beyond. In the late game, use your auras to improve your team’s staying power in team fights.
Zilean.teamfight: Stay behind your allies, within aura range. Before an engage, use Sona E Song of Celerity; during a fight, use Sona W Aria of Perseverance and Sona Q Hymn of Valor as the situation calls for. Stop enemies diving onto your damage dealers with Sona R Crescendo. Don’t spend abilities on an enemy affected by Zilean R Chronoshift while they are reviving. If they’re difficult to finish off, switch your target to the squishy Zilean himself.
Zilean.watch: When Zilean Q Time Bomb attaches to the same target twice, it stuns them. Once the first bomb attaches, move away from allies and out of its blast radius. When the second bomb is flying toward you, use Sona W Aria of Perseverance to absorb the damage. If Zilean E Time Warp slows you, you can easily get caught in the bomb combo, so don’t engage alone.

Zyra.build: Early on, survive with a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Zyra deals mostly magic damage, and Sona has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If Zyra can lock down and burst your damage dealers, fit Mikael’s Blessing in between your core items.
Zyra.combo: Hit Zyra with Sona Q Hymn of Valor, then let your ADC make a basic attack while benefiting from Q’s aura. If Zyra retaliates, absorb the damage with Sona W Aria of Perseverance, then finish with the next Sona Q Hymn of Valor for Sona P Power Chord’s bonus damage. If you can close the distance after Zyra E Grasping Roots is down, stun her with Sona R Crescendo.
Zyra.escape: Dodging Zyra E Grasping Roots creates an opening to engage. Zyra has no ability to create distance on her own, so close in then and stun her with Sona R Crescendo. If you see the indicator for Zyra R Stranglethorns, stop your engage and walk out of its area.
Zyra.fight: Dodge Zyra E Grasping Roots by moving sideways, then close the distance when there are no plants. Poke with Sona Q Hymn of Valor and move close enough for your ADC to receive Q’s aura and make a basic attack. If Zyra retaliates, time Sona W Aria of Perseverance for when the damage lands.
Zyra.laning: Early on, keep your distance and get good hits with Sona Q Hymn of Valor. Save Sona W Aria of Perseverance for when you take Zyra’s damage. Step on Zyra’s seeds to remove them when it’s safe, but if Zyra is about to use an ability, back away and step on them again afterward. Don’t enter bushes where Zyra has lingered or areas without vision alone.
Zyra.phase: Sona is weak early on and in danger if caught, so survive by building magic resistance and managing your distance. From mid game, Sona’s growth stacks and support items speed up her ability rotations. In the late game, use your auras to improve your team’s staying power in team fights.
Zyra.teamfight: If Zyra has built up seeds and plants in an area, don’t take a fight there. Move to another objective and fight on fresh terrain. Use Sona E Song of Celerity to speed up your allies’ engage, then use Sona W Aria of Perseverance and Sona Q Hymn of Valor as the situation calls for while staying within aura range of your allies. If crowd control from Zyra is locking down your damage dealers, prioritize a cleanse, and use Sona R Crescendo to stop enemies who engage.
Zyra.watch: If Zyra E Grasping Roots roots you, her plants can damage you and Zyra R Stranglethorns can knock you up. Dodge E by moving sideways at the edge of its range. When you see the cast indicator for Zyra R Stranglethorns, walk out of its area. Don’t fight where her plants have gathered; briefly fall back and wait for them to disappear.
